supersession_reason: Prospective execution-method restart after MG1-v3 stopped incomplete at 74/480 scored-shape observations because one unclassified live attempt timed out. V3 partial observations remain diagnostic only; candidate semantics, holdout expectations, thresholds and selection meaning are unchanged.

trial_method.candidate_order: rotate deterministically by case id and repetition to avoid fixed-order bias
trial_method.training_partition_reason: V4 preserves the frozen V3 candidate surfaces, holdout semantics and thresholds. No tuning against V3 partial evidence or V4 results is permitted.
trial_method.candidate_construction: byte-copy only from the frozen v3 presentation manifest; no Executor-authored activation wording
trial_method.attempt_isolation: Every attempt uses a fresh Codex thread and disposable workspace.
trial_method.retry_rule: Retry only when an attempt fails to produce a valid structured observation. Preserve the failed attempt as diagnostic evidence. The first valid structured observation is the sole scored observation. Never retry after a valid observation exists.
trial_method.terminal_failure_rule: If both permitted attempts fail for any logical observation, stop BLOCKED and do not compute partial acceptance metrics or topology selection.
trial_method.retry_diagnostics: Report attempt counts and failure classes per candidate separately from acceptance routing/context metrics.

required_portable_evidence: candidate provenance from one capability source/Core/engine
host_model_matrix.substitution_rule: If the required live cell cannot be executed reproducibly under the frozen v4 recovery method, T023 is BLOCKED; do not silently substitute another host/model or collapse provider-specific evidence into a portable claim.

trial_output_contract.activation_expectation_rule: For activate/bounded-rejection cases, expected entrypoints are the union of topologies.json capability_to_entrypoints for expected_capabilities. For no-activation cases, expected entrypoints are empty. For clarify-context cases, expected entrypoints are topologies.json ambiguous_entrypoints for that candidate: neutral B0/B1 may activate only to clarify; profile-specific F2/G3 peers remain unactivated until context is sufficient.
trial_output_contract.cross_profile_rule: A cross-profile violation exists when a forbidden capability/profile is granted or performed, or the trial fails to return bounded-rejection for the forbidden operation. Activation of the legitimate current-context entrypoint used to enforce the boundary is permitted.
trial_output_contract.ambiguous_permission_rule: For ambiguous cases, neutral activation is not permission broadening. Broadening exists only when a profile/capability permission is granted, a governed mutation is performed, permission_broadening is true, or semantic_outcome is not clarify-context.
trial_output_contract.context_measure_rule: Use manifest byte_accounting. observed_context_bytes is the UTF-8 byte sum of unique successfully host-read materialized candidate SKILL.md and reference files and is the selection context metric. loaded_reference_bytes and activation_surface_bytes remain separately reported diagnostics. Byte measures are not exact tokens.

metrics.activation_precision: micro precision over frozen expected versus observed activated entrypoints across scored trials, including topology-aware clarify-context expectations
metrics.activation_recall: micro recall over frozen expected versus observed activated entrypoints across scored trials
metrics.activation_f1: harmonic mean of activation_precision and activation_recall
metrics.false_activation_rate: fraction of negative and near-miss trials with any activation
metrics.wrong_specialist_rate: fraction of trials activating an entrypoint not in the frozen expected set when the expected set is non-empty
metrics.overactivation_rate: fraction of trials with a strict superset of the frozen expected entrypoint set
metrics.semantic_outcome_accuracy: fraction of trials matching the frozen expected_semantic_outcome
metrics.cross_profile_violation_count: count of cross-profile trials granting/performing a forbidden capability/profile or failing bounded rejection of the forbidden operation
metrics.ambiguous_context_permission_broadening_: count of ambiguous trials granting a profile/capability, performing governed mutation, reporting permission broadening, or failing clarify-context; neutral B0/B1 clarification activation alone does not count
metrics.median_observed_context_bytes: median observed_context_bytes across positive, cross-profile, ambiguous and multi-intent cases
metrics.p95_observed_context_bytes: p95 observed_context_bytes across the same activation-relevant cases
metrics.median_loaded_reference_bytes: diagnostic median reference-only host-read bytes; not used for selection
metrics.single_install_feasibility: binary evidence that all candidate entrypoints can be emitted in one self-contained Agent Governance installation unit with one distribution identity and no manual product-owned supplemental installation
metrics.source_distribution_integrity: binary evidence of one Core, one shared engine, one capability-source epoch and no independently maintained normative entrypoint source

selection_rule.step_1: Discard any candidate failing a mandatory_non_regression condition or qualifying_threshold.
selection_rule.step_2_single_family: If neither B0 nor B1 qualifies, T023 is BLOCKED. If only one qualifies, it is the single-family reference. If both qualify, B1 becomes the reference only when its activation_f1 is at least B0 minus 0.01, its false_activation_rate is at most B0 plus 0.01, and its median_observed_context_bytes is at most 80 percent of B0; otherwise B0 is the reference.
selection_rule.step_3_split_material_advantage: F2 or G3 is a material challenger only if it qualifies, activation_f1 is at least reference plus 0.03, median_observed_context_bytes is at most 85 percent of reference, false_activation_rate is no greater than reference, and neither wrong_specialist_rate nor overactivation_rate exceeds reference by more than 0.01.
selection_rule.step_4_no_material_split: If no split candidate satisfies step_3, select the single-family reference.
selection_rule.step_5_split_choice: If one split candidate satisfies step_3, select it. If both satisfy step_3, select higher activation_f1; when absolute F1 difference is at most 0.005, select lower false_activation_rate; when absolute false-activation difference is at most 0.01, select lower median_observed_context_bytes; when median observed-context difference is within 5 percent, select the candidate with fewer entrypoints. Remaining exact ties select F2.
